name: signed-or-absolute
title: Signed or absolute gender gap
idea: Grading the signed gender gap and grading its size answer different questions: which firm has the larger gap in size does not follow from the signed pair probabilities.
from: new angle · builds on 5.3's gender card; adds the absolute (folded) gender target of pr_case_krw with its own pair probabilities, and two reports computed the same way (the best cuts of each target's expected-rank order, at most 4 grades at τ .20, labeled optimal within this order) with the pairs whose order differs
credit: Signed and absolute targets after the postrank theory book, ch. 4 and 20, and the postrank vignette a3; gender gaps after Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), section VIII (gender target). Firms as adapted in postrank 1.1.0 (pr_case_krw).
caption: All 97 firms; exact released contact-gap pair probabilities and supplied central 90% intervals. The data describe KRW’s historical experiment, not any firm’s current conduct.
